cues: Ben Okri was born in Nigeria in nineteen fifty nine; your textbook's nineteen forty nine is a misprint.
He spent his early childhood in London, then returned to Nigeria during its civil war.
His novel The Famished Road won the Booker Prize when he was only thirty two.
Critics call him a magical realist; he replies that in his tradition there are simply more dimensions to reality: myths, ancestors, spirits.
He was knighted in twenty twenty three.
